assumptions: NWC equals 0.10 of current-year revenue in Years 1–6; terminal NWC is zero after liquidation.
The Year 1 loss immediately reduces tax paid on other group income.
Initial NWC remains EUR 80,000 as either sensitivity input changes.
Sales scale within existing capacity; no additional CAPEX is modelled.
Past R&D and allocated existing corporate costs are excluded.
Q2 preset applies 1.10 times Q1 units and a net annual fixed-cost change of EUR -20,000; other inputs are shared.
Price is realised net selling price; variable unit cost and price scale uniformly across Years 1–7.
Price elasticity is hypothetical and constant, not estimated or endorsed as a forecast.
Demand coefficient is measured before price response; price changes also alter current-year-revenue NWC.
Incremental marketing and distribution spending must be included in fixed or variable costs; extra capacity CAPEX and minimum-order inventory effects need separate extension.
Positive NPV regions are deterministic model feasibility, not probabilities, confidence intervals or a safety guarantee.

scenario_extensions.classification: Illustrative management sensitivities; no estimated price elasticity supplied in the case
scenario_extensions.cashflow_scope: Full project, before investment; continuation decisions after launch require remaining avoidable cash flows
